patch_list: Force enable Megaphone, Tamper Detection, Krutrim and Kruti

Forces the Megaphone, Tamper & Fall Detection, Krutrim Assistant, and Kruti features to always report as available, regardless of the server-driven onboarding feature flags returned by the app's backend.

patch_list: Allows cleartext HTTP connections to local self-hosted servers.
Disables root detection, allowing the app to run on rooted devices.
Disables SSL certificate pinning to allow intercepting and inspecting network traffic.
Disables hostname verification and certificate chain validation for self-signed or invalid certificates.
Reroute API Calls to Self-Hosted Server
Redirects API requests from Ola servers to your custom backend.
